annotations.title: Scan one act for a term

description: EVERY article of ONE act containing a literal term — exhaustive, not ranked. Use this for 'which articles of this law mention X', 'find everything in this act about Y', or to establish that a term does NOT appear in an act. search_semantic and search_lexical cannot answer this: they rank by relevance across the whole corpus, and an article that mentions a term in passing does not score as being ABOUT it. This reads every node of the act with no relevance threshold and reports how many it read, so the answer can be cited as complete. Romanian inflects: pass the declined forms too ('patrimoniul mondial' does not match 'Lista patrimoniului mondial').

law.description: The act to scan, e.g. 'legea 350/2001' or 'codul fiscal'.

terms.description: Literal strings to look for, up to 12, e.g. ['UNESCO', 'patrimoniul mondial', 'patrimoniului mondial']. Matched case-insensitively as substrings — not stemmed, so include the inflected forms.

name: scan_act_for_terms
